items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper for merging Tailwind classes.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A toggle button that flips between light and dark mode with an expanding circular reveal.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code input that grows out of a button and settles into a verified badge.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A toast notification whose status lands with a rippling pulse and whose text morphs word by word.

items.name: audio-chat-room
items.title: Audio Chat Room
items.description: A voice chat pill that morphs into a card showing everyone in the room.

items.name: member-selector
items.title: Member Selector
items.description: An avatar row for picking people, with a searchable dropdown to add more.

items.name: ascii-jellyfish
items.title: Ascii Jellyfish
items.description: Translucent jellyfish drawn as ASCII glyphs, pulsing through the water with trailing tentacles.

items.name: ascii-butterflies
items.title: Ascii Butterflies
items.description: A few butterflies drawn as ASCII glyphs, flapping on wandering paths and landing now and then.

items.name: swarm-reveal
items.title: Swarm Reveal
items.description: A wrapper that has a swarm of cursors build your page in front of the visitor when it loads.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to Refresh
items.description: A pull-to-refresh container with a masked pixel hero who climbs into the gap and holds up the page.

items.name: spider-cursor
items.title: Spider Cursor
items.description: A scroll container whose cursor is a red spider mask that swings the page on a web line, webs up what you click, and hauls draggable items around on a thread.

items.name: tracked-butterfly-ascii
items.title: Tracked Butterfly Ascii
items.description: A butterfly drawn in WebGL as a fine grid of glowing cells, under a motion tracking overlay that marks points on its wings.

items.name: dimension-hero
items.title: Dimension Hero
items.description: A bold headline hero with a pill that turns the page into a black wireframe world of extruded letters.

items.name: poster-sphere
items.title: Poster Sphere
items.description: A movie browser that swells an endless wall of posters under a lens and opens each film in a full screen view.

items.name: gallery-corridor
items.title: Gallery Corridor
items.description: A portfolio hero that walks you down a bending wireframe corridor hung with glowing pieces of work.

items.name: comic-glitch-text
items.title: Comic Glitch Text
items.description: A paragraph that glitches in word by word through comic panels, torn color slices and print misregistration.

items.name: metal-button
items.title: Metal Button
items.description: A liquid metal ring with a wandering halo for buttons, icons, text and badges.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A squircle button that changes shape to show its state.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field whose label floats up out of the way as you type.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A soft multi-line field that grows with its text.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A squircle checkbox whose tick draws itself in.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off switch with a springy thumb.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A list of options where exactly one can be picked.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider made of tick marks that swell under your pointer.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown list for picking one value.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A row of tabs with a sliding pill that switches between panels.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small label that floats beside an element on hover or focus.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, for small forms and details.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window that dims the page and holds focus until it is closed.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that drops from a trigger.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small tinted label for status, counts and tags.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A squircle portrait with initials as a fallback and an optional status dot.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A large soft squircle surface for grouping related content.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline that divides content, across or down.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A slim bar that shows how far along a task is.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A soft placeholder block that stands in for content while it loads.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A smooth line chart for one or more series over time.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: A line chart with a soft fill that fades down to its baseline.
